title: 369 Spartina Circle Vacation Rental
meta_description: 369 Spartina Circle is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 9 Passes Included- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 2 Vehicles ( Garage Access Not Available)- Propane Grill- Large Cover Porches - Outdoor Fire Pit- 2 Minute Walk to Camp Watercolor- 5 Minute Bike Ride to Watercolor Beach Club Access- 4 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 369 Spartina Circle! This modern luxury living is located just steps away from the pool and park at Camp WaterColor, a perfect spot for families to come together and relax. With its professional designer interiors and ideal location, this home creates an inviting space for your best vacation experience yet! The spacious floor plan features a large living room for relaxing and enjoying your family. The full kitchen features custom finishes, stainless steel appliances, and large dining area for everyone to enjoy a family meal together. The first floor also features a large master suite with king bed and private bathroom. Located down the hall, the kids will enjoy the built in bunk beds which sleep a total of three in twin beds. Walk up the custom finished staircase to find a second living space that overlooks the first floor living area and also has access to a large balcony. The second floor also features king and queen suites across the hall from each other sleeping a total of four upstairs. The designer touches continue outside as you enjoy the tranquility of WaterColor from any of the porches of this wonderful home. You can curl and and read on the front porch after a long day at the beach, or relax and unwind on the back porch while watching the kids play in the park. 369 Spartina Circle is truly an unique home for a WaterColor vacation to remember! FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Bunk Nook: Triple Decker Twin Bunk Beds (3), Shared Half Bathroom- Laundry Room SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower PLEASE NOTE: All golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
